metadata.description: Agent skills for starting projects, product videos, driving your own browser, shrinking Git history and setting up global agent instructions.

plugins.name: product-video
plugins.description: Use when the user wants a demo or promo video of their app, a product walkthrough, or a voice-over script for one.

plugins.name: use-my-browser
plugins.description: Use when the user asks you to use their own browser (Chrome, Brave or Chromium) to open pages, click around or take screenshots while signed in.

plugins.name: git-history-cleanup
plugins.description: Use when a Git repository is too big or slow to clone because of large files committed in the past, and the user wants them removed from its history.

plugins.name: global-instructions
plugins.description: Use when the user wants to set up or update their personal global instructions (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) and favorite skills for coding agents on this computer.

plugins.name: create-ej-app
plugins.description: Use when the user wants to create or start a new web app, SaaS product or API project.
